<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_Restaurant" targetNamespace="http://example.com/restaurant">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_MealOrder" name="Meal order"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_BuzzerAndInstruction" name="Buzzer and instruction"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_NewMealOrder" name="New meal order"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_MealReady" name="Meal ready"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_BuzzerRings" name="Buzzer rings"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_GuestArrival" name="Guest arrives at service hatch"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_MealHandover" name="Meal handover"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CallForGuest" name="Call for guest"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Restaurant">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Guest" name="Guest" processRef="Process_Guest"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Employee" name="Employee" processRef="Process_Employee"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Chef" name="Chef" processRef="Process_Chef"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Order" name="Meal order" sourceRef="Task_PlaceOrder" targetRef="Start_OrderReceived" messageRef="Message_MealOrder"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_BuzzerHandover" name="Buzzer and instruction" sourceRef="Task_HandBuzzer" targetRef="Task_ReceiveBuzzer" messageRef="Message_BuzzerAndInstruction"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_NewOrder" name="New meal order" sourceRef="Task_InformChef" targetRef="Start_NewOrder" messageRef="Message_NewMealOrder"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_MealReady" name="Meal ready" sourceRef="Task_InformEmployee" targetRef="Task_ReceiveMealReady" messageRef="Message_MealReady"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_BuzzerRings" name="Buzzer rings" sourceRef="Task_SetOffBuzzer" targetRef="Event_BuzzerRings" messageRef="Message_BuzzerRings"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_GuestArrival" name="Guest arrives at service hatch" sourceRef="Task_AnnounceArrival" targetRef="Task_ReceiveGuestArrival" messageRef="Message_GuestArrival"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_MealHandover" name="Meal handover" sourceRef="Task_HandOverMeal" targetRef="Task_ReceiveMeal" messageRef="Message_MealHandover"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CallForGuest" name="Call for guest" sourceRef="Task_CallGuest" targetRef="Boundary_CallReceived" messageRef="Message_CallForGuest"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Guest" name="Guest meal process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_GuestHungry" name="Feels hungry">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Guest_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnterRestaurant" name="Enter restaurant">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Guest_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Guest_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ChooseDish" name="Choose a dish from the changing meal range">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Guest_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Guest_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_WaitTurn" name="Wait until it is his turn">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Guest_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Guest_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_PlaceOrder" name="Place meal order" messageRef="Message_MealOrder">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Guest_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Guest_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveBuzzer" name="Receive buzzer and instruction" messageRef="Message_BuzzerAndInstruction">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Guest_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Guest_6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_BuzzerRings" name="Buzzer rings">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Guest_6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Guest_7</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_BuzzerRings" messageRef="Message_BuzzerRings"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GoToHatch" name="Go to the service hatch">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Guest_7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Guest_8</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="Boundary_CallReceived" name="Employee calls" attachedToRef="Task_GoToHatch" cancelActivity="false">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Guest_Call_1</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_CallReceived" messageRef="Message_CallForGuest"/>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_HearCall" name="Hear employee's call">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Guest_Call_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Guest_Call_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_GuestCallHeard" name="Call heard">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Guest_Call_2</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_AnnounceArrival" name="Appear at the service hatch" messageRef="Message_GuestArrival">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Guest_8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Guest_9</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveMeal" name="Receive meal" messageRef="Message_MealHandover">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Guest_9</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Guest_10</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EatMeal" name="Eat meal">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Guest_10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Guest_11</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_GuestMeal" name="Meal eaten">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Guest_11</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Guest_1" sourceRef="Start_GuestHungry" targetRef="Task_EnterRestaurant"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Guest_2" sourceRef="Task_EnterRestaurant" targetRef="Task_ChooseDish"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Guest_3" sourceRef="Task_ChooseDish" targetRef="Task_WaitTurn"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Guest_4" sourceRef="Task_WaitTurn" targetRef="Task_PlaceOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Guest_5" sourceRef="Task_PlaceOrder" targetRef="Task_ReceiveBuzzer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Guest_6" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveBuzzer" targetRef="Event_BuzzerRings"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Guest_7" sourceRef="Event_BuzzerRings" targetRef="Task_GoToHatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Guest_8" sourceRef="Task_GoToHatch" targetRef="Task_AnnounceArrival"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Guest_9" sourceRef="Task_AnnounceArrival" targetRef="Task_ReceiveMeal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Guest_10" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveMeal" targetRef="Task_EatMeal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Guest_11" sourceRef="Task_EatMeal" targetRef="End_GuestMeal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Guest_Call_1" sourceRef="Boundary_CallReceived" targetRef="Task_HearCall"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Guest_Call_2" sourceRef="Task_HearCall" targetRef="End_GuestCallHeard"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Employee" name="Employee meal service process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_OrderReceived" name="Meal order received">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Employee_1</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_OrderReceived" messageRef="Message_MealOrder"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnterOrderPOS" name="Enter order into POS system">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Employee_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Employee_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CollectMoney" name="Collect money from guest">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Employee_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Employee_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_HandBuzzer" name="Set up buzzer, hand it to guest and explain" messageRef="Message_BuzzerAndInstruction">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Employee_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Employee_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_InformChef" name="Inform chef of new meal order" messageRef="Message_NewMealOrder">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Employee_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Employee_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveMealReady" name="Receive chef's meal-ready information" messageRef="Message_MealReady">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Employee_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Employee_6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SetOffBuzzer" name="Set off guest's buzzer" messageRef="Message_BuzzerRings">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Employee_6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Employee_7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_WaitForGuestOrTimer" name="Wait for guest or five minutes">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Employee_7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Employee_Timer</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Employee_Arrival</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:eventBasedGateway>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_FiveMinutes" name="Five minutes pass">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Employee_Timer</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Employee_Call</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerEventDefinition_FiveMinutes">
        <bpmn:timeDuration>PT5M</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_CallGuest" name="Call for guest" messageRef="Message_CallForGuest">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Employee_Call</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Employee_CallLoop</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveGuestArrival" name="Notice guest at service hatch" messageRef="Message_GuestArrival">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Employee_Arrival</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Employee_8</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_HandOverMeal" name="Hand over meal to guest" messageRef="Message_MealHandover">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Employee_8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Employee_9</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_EmployeeHandover" name="Meal handed over">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Employee_9</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employee_1" sourceRef="Start_OrderReceived" targetRef="Task_EnterOrderPOS"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employee_2" sourceRef="Task_EnterOrderPOS" targetRef="Task_CollectMoney"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employee_3" sourceRef="Task_CollectMoney" targetRef="Task_HandBuzzer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employee_4" sourceRef="Task_HandBuzzer" targetRef="Task_InformChef"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employee_5" sourceRef="Task_InformChef" targetRef="Task_ReceiveMealReady"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employee_6" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveMealReady" targetRef="Task_SetOffBuzzer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employee_7" sourceRef="Task_SetOffBuzzer" targetRef="Gateway_WaitForGuestOrTimer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employee_Timer" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForGuestOrTimer" targetRef="Event_FiveMinutes"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employee_Call" sourceRef="Event_FiveMinutes" targetRef="Task_CallGuest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employee_CallLoop" sourceRef="Task_CallGuest" targetRef="Gateway_WaitForGuestOrTimer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employee_Arrival" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForGuestOrTimer" targetRef="Task_ReceiveGuestArrival"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employee_8" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveGuestArrival" targetRef="Task_HandOverMeal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employee_9" sourceRef="Task_HandOverMeal" targetRef="End_EmployeeHandover"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Chef" name="Chef meal preparation process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_NewOrder" name="New meal order received">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Chef_1</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_NewOrder" messageRef="Message_NewMealOrder"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareMeal" name="Prepare meal">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Chef_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Chef_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PlaceMealHatch" name="Place meal in service hatch">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Chef_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Chef_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_InformEmployee" name="Inform employee meal is ready in the service hatch" messageRef="Message_MealReady">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Chef_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Chef_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ChefNotified" name="Employee informed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Chef_4</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Chef_1" sourceRef="Start_NewOrder" targetRef="Task_PrepareMeal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Chef_2" sourceRef="Task_PrepareMeal" targetRef="Task_PlaceMealHatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Chef_3" sourceRef="Task_PlaceMealHatch" targetRef="Task_InformEmployee"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Chef_4" sourceRef="Task_InformEmployee" targetRef="End_ChefNotified"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_Restaurant" targetNamespace="http://example.com/restaurant">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_MealOrder" name="Meal order"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_BuzzerInstruction" name="Buzzer and readiness instruction"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_NewMealOrder" name="New meal order for chef"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_MealReady" name="Meal placed in service hatch"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_BuzzerRings" name="Buzzer rings"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CallForGuest" name="Employee calls for guest"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_GuestAtHatch" name="Guest appears at service hatch"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_MealHandover" name="Meal handover"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Restaurant">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Guest" name="Guest" processRef="Process_Guest"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Employee" name="Employee" processRef="Process_Employee"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Chef" name="Chef" processRef="Process_Chef"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Order" name="Guest places order with employee" sourceRef="Task_PlaceOrder" targetRef="Start_OrderReceived" messageRef="Message_MealOrder"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_BuzzerInstruction" name="Employee gives guest buzzer and instruction" sourceRef="Task_GiveBuzzer" targetRef="Task_ReceiveBuzzer" messageRef="Message_BuzzerInstruction"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_NewOrder" name="Employee informs chef of new order" sourceRef="Task_InformChef" targetRef="Start_NewOrder" messageRef="Message_NewMealOrder"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_MealReady" name="Chef informs employee meal is in hatch" sourceRef="Task_InformEmployee" targetRef="Task_ReceiveMealReady" messageRef="Message_MealReady"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_BuzzerRings" name="Employee sets off guest's buzzer" sourceRef="Task_SetOffBuzzer" targetRef="Event_BuzzerRings" messageRef="Message_BuzzerRings"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CallForGuest" name="Employee calls for guest" sourceRef="Task_CallGuest" targetRef="Event_GuestHearsCall" messageRef="Message_CallForGuest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_GuestAtHatch" name="Guest appears at hatch; employee notices" sourceRef="Task_AppearAtHatch" targetRef="Task_NoticeGuest" messageRef="Message_GuestAtHatch"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_MealHandover" name="Employee hands meal to guest" sourceRef="Task_HandOverMeal" targetRef="Task_ReceiveMeal" messageRef="Message_MealHandover"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Guest" name="Guest meal process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_GuestHungry" name="Guest feels hungry">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Guest_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnterRestaurant" name="Enter restaurant">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Guest_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Guest_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ChooseDish" name="Choose a dish from the changing meal range">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Guest_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Guest_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_WaitTurn" name="Wait until it is his turn">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Guest_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Guest_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_PlaceOrder" name="Place order with employee" messageRef="Message_MealOrder">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Guest_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Guest_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveBuzzer" name="Receive buzzer and readiness instruction" messageRef="Message_BuzzerInstruction">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Guest_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Guest_6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_WaitForBuzzerOrCall" name="Wait for buzzer or employee call">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Guest_6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Guest_Buzzer</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Guest_Call</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:eventBasedGateway>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_BuzzerRings" name="Buzzer rings">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Guest_Buzzer</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Guest_BuzzerToMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_BuzzerRings" messageRef="Message_BuzzerRings"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_GuestHearsCall" name="Guest hears employee call">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Guest_Call</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Guest_CallToMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_GuestHearsCall" messageRef="Message_CallForGuest"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BuzzerOrCallMerge" name="Buzzer or call received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Guest_BuzzerToMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Guest_CallToMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Guest_7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_AppearAtHatch" name="Appear at the service hatch" messageRef="Message_GuestAtHatch">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Guest_7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Guest_8</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveMeal" name="Receive meal from employee" messageRef="Message_MealHandover">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Guest_8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Guest_9</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EatMeal" name="Eat meal">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Guest_9</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Guest_10</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_GuestMealEaten" name="Meal eaten">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Guest_10</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Guest_1" sourceRef="Start_GuestHungry" targetRef="Task_EnterRestaurant"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Guest_2" sourceRef="Task_EnterRestaurant" targetRef="Task_ChooseDish"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Guest_3" sourceRef="Task_ChooseDish" targetRef="Task_WaitTurn"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Guest_4" sourceRef="Task_WaitTurn" targetRef="Task_PlaceOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Guest_5" sourceRef="Task_PlaceOrder" targetRef="Task_ReceiveBuzzer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Guest_6" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveBuzzer" targetRef="Gateway_WaitForBuzzerOrCall"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Guest_Buzzer" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForBuzzerOrCall" targetRef="Event_BuzzerRings"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Guest_Call" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForBuzzerOrCall" targetRef="Event_GuestHearsCall"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Guest_BuzzerToMerge" sourceRef="Event_BuzzerRings" targetRef="Gateway_BuzzerOrCallMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Guest_CallToMerge" sourceRef="Event_GuestHearsCall" targetRef="Gateway_BuzzerOrCallMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Guest_7" sourceRef="Gateway_BuzzerOrCallMerge" targetRef="Task_AppearAtHatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Guest_8" sourceRef="Task_AppearAtHatch" targetRef="Task_ReceiveMeal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Guest_9" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveMeal" targetRef="Task_EatMeal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Guest_10" sourceRef="Task_EatMeal" targetRef="End_GuestMealEaten"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Employee" name="Employee meal service process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_OrderReceived" name="Guest order received">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Employee_1</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_OrderReceived" messageRef="Message_MealOrder"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnterOrderPOS" name="Enter order into POS system">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Employee_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Employee_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CollectMoney" name="Collect money from guest">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Employee_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Employee_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_GiveBuzzer" name="Set up buzzer, give it to guest, and explain: "When the buzzer rings, your dinner is ready"" messageRef="Message_BuzzerInstruction">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Employee_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Employee_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_InformChef" name="Inform chef of new meal order" messageRef="Message_NewMealOrder">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Employee_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Employee_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveMealReady" name="Receive chef's notice that meal is in the service hatch" messageRef="Message_MealReady">

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Employee_6</bpmn:outgoing>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SetOffBuzzer" name="Set off guest's buzzer" messageRef="Message_BuzzerRings">

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Employee_7</bpmn:outgoing>

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Employee_Timer</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Employee_Arrival</bpmn:outgoing>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_FiveMinutes" name="Five minutes pass">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Employee_Timer</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Employee_Call</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerEventDefinition_FiveMinutes">
        <bpmn:timeDuration>PT5M</bpmn:timeDuration>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_CallGuest" name="Call for guest" messageRef="Message_CallForGuest">

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Employee_CallLoop</bpmn:outgoing>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_HandOverMeal" name="Hand over meal to guest" messageRef="Message_MealHandover">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Employee_8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Employee_9</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_EmployeeHandover" name="Meal handed over">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Employee_9</bpmn:incoming>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employee_1" sourceRef="Start_OrderReceived" targetRef="Task_EnterOrderPOS"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employee_2" sourceRef="Task_EnterOrderPOS" targetRef="Task_CollectMoney"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employee_3" sourceRef="Task_CollectMoney" targetRef="Task_GiveBuzzer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employee_4" sourceRef="Task_GiveBuzzer" targetRef="Task_InformChef"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employee_5" sourceRef="Task_InformChef" targetRef="Task_ReceiveMealReady"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employee_6" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveMealReady" targetRef="Task_SetOffBuzzer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employee_7" sourceRef="Task_SetOffBuzzer" targetRef="Gateway_WaitForGuestOrFiveMinutes"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employee_Timer" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForGuestOrFiveMinutes" targetRef="Event_FiveMinutes"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employee_Call" sourceRef="Event_FiveMinutes" targetRef="Task_CallGuest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employee_CallLoop" sourceRef="Task_CallGuest" targetRef="Gateway_WaitForGuestOrFiveMinutes"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employee_Arrival" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForGuestOrFiveMinutes" targetRef="Task_NoticeGuest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employee_8" sourceRef="Task_NoticeGuest" targetRef="Task_HandOverMeal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employee_9" sourceRef="Task_HandOverMeal" targetRef="End_EmployeeHandover"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Chef" name="Chef meal preparation process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_NewOrder" name="New meal order received">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Chef_1</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_NewOrder" messageRef="Message_NewMealOrder"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareMeal" name="Prepare meal">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Chef_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Chef_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PlaceMealInHatch" name="Place meal in service hatch">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Chef_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Chef_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_InformEmployee" name="Inform employee meal is in the service hatch" messageRef="Message_MealReady">

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Chef_4</bpmn:outgoing>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Chef_1" sourceRef="Start_NewOrder" targetRef="Task_PrepareMeal"/>

  </bpmn:process>
